verdicts.evidence: Changing `.split("\\").join("/")` to `.join("")` changed the derived path on the fixture whose entry module carries a backslash in its name: `src/a/b.ts` became `src/ab.ts`. verdicts.evidence: The default only feeds tomlStringList, which returns null for any string not starting with "[", so "" and "Stryker was here!" both yield null and the loop continues. Measured: byte-identical Derivations across 29 projects. verdicts.evidence: `bindings.some((b) => true)` asks whether ANY manifest has bound something, not whether THIS one did, and `bindings` accumulates across manifests. Measured on a project holding `wrangler.a.toml` (declares crons) and `wrangler.b.json` (declares nothing): the delivered code emits `no schedule or queue consumer declared` for wrangler.b.json, the mutant emits nothing at all — the second Worker's silence becomes indistinguishable from an unexamined file.
